title: Power Formula
text: Power dissipated in a resistor can be calculated using P = I^2 * R. For internal resistance, use P = I^2 * r where r is the internal resistance.

title: Calculate the Power
text: Substitute: P = (4 A)^2 * 0.5 ohm = 16 * 0.5 = 8 W. This power is converted to heat inside the battery.
